post.description:
Verify OTP code:
- If register: atomically creates user profile and default personal group, returns custom_token.
- If forgot_password: returns a reset_token for resetting password.
Resend OTP challenge with 60s cooldown enforcement.

patch.summary: Update camera AI detection & schedule config (Patch)
patch.description:
Save per-camera AI mode (ALWAYS | SCHEDULE | OFF) and up to 2 rest schedule slots (Figma H10-H15).
RBAC: STRICTLY ONLY LEADER (Screen H8: 'Chỉ chủ nhóm được đổi cài đặt AI').
Simultaneously pushes `SET_CAMERA_AI_CONFIG` down to the Edge Gateway (`edge-backend` -> `firewatch-ai`)
to immediately connect or disconnect the RTSP input stream to the AI worker.

Phase 1 Fast Signal Webhook (<30ms):
Receives lightweight fire signal JSON (~0.6KB) from Edge AI / EAG.
1. Upserts event into Cloud Firestore (indexed by event_id or debounced 90s).
2. If SUPPRESSED or REJECTED: cancels Redis escalation timer and notifies Frontend.
3. If active fire: starts Redis Two-Tier Escalation Timer (ADR 0011) and broadcasts Level 0 alert.
4. If snapshot_base64 is present, queues Phase 2 background storage upload.
